baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 1, 4, and 6 join enduring residence, seeking, and transfer.
baseline_models.mechanism: Duration, desire, and transition form a closed mechanism: enduring residence is matched by the absence of any sought move away, so permanence is inwardly ratified rather than merely imposed.

activation_trace.role: Stable survival without quick decay supplies the durable condition of residence.
Goal-directed seeking supplies the volitional axis, here explicitly negated.
Movement from one place or condition to another specifies what desire does not pursue.

changed_reading.after: Their enduring location and their preference coincide: no elsewhere or otherwise becomes an object of pursuit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The in-it and away-from-it construction surrounds the transfer noun at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pronouns establish a location, while the state branch of the transfer root broadens the negated alternative from another address to another mode of being.

activation_trace.role: Durable continuity keeps the reading anchored in unending residence.
Seeking makes an alternate condition a possible object of appetite, then negates it.
The field of changing human conditions expands transfer beyond a merely spatial move.

changed_reading.before: They do not want another place.
changed_reading.after: They seek neither another location nor a changed condition; the whole mode of life is unexchangeable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The abiding participle at word 1 is coordinated with the negated search away from the pronominal place.
baseline_models.mechanism: Permanence can carry the texture of adhesion and settled attachment: the inhabitants are not only retained in the place but belong to it so fully that surrounding alternatives do not solicit them.

activation_trace.role: Adhesion, contented leaning, and staying supply an affective bond to the abode.
Negated pursuit shows that attachment governs preference rather than only duration.
The surrounding directional field supplies the alternatives around the abode that never become destinations.

changed_reading.before: They are kept permanently in the garden.
changed_reading.after: Their permanence has the character of belonging: the abode holds them because their desire rests there.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope opens with parts surging into one another and then being gathered; against that kinetic compression, the focus becomes the settled terminus after disordered motion has been resolved.

activation_trace.role: Interpenetrating turbulence supplies the initial regime of unstable motion.
Joining dispersed parts into a collected whole supplies the transition from turbulence to ordered assembly.
Stable endurance supplies the terminal condition reached after the gathering sequence.
Negated transition closes the movement opened by the surging and gathering.

structural_cues: 18:99 places intermingled motion before total gathering; 18:108 closes the positive destination with no sought transfer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turbulence, gathering, and final permanence; I infer an arrow from chaotic mobility through assembly to settled allotment. Alternatively, 18:99 may stage resurrection without defining the garden's experience.

changed_reading.before: The residents simply remain in one place.
changed_reading.after: Their no-transfer state is the resolved endpoint of a sequence that first unsettles and gathers creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby negative condition is explicit inability to hear, whereas the focus negates seeking. This contrast makes satisfied volition, not incapacity, the foregrounded reason no transfer is pursued.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and ability supply the explicit deprivation against which the focus's verb of seeking can be distinguished.
Negated goal-directed seeking locates the absence in appetite rather than expressly in power.
Enduring residence remains the condition whose volitional quality is being clarified.

structural_cues: 18:101 says they were not able to hear; 18:108 says they do not seek a transfer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a local lexical contrast between inability and non-seeking; I infer that the latter foregrounds contentment. This does not prove that departure is possible, only that inability is not the focus's stated mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They never leave because leaving is unavailable.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents no appetite for departure, not an assertion of incapacity; permanence is experienced as wanted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Both destinies are called prepared reception, but only the garden reception is immediately followed by abiding and no desired transfer. The focus turns the arrival provision of a guest into fully adopted home.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arriving guest labels the negative destination and establishes the repeated reception frame.
The same prepared-reception image labels the garden, allowing the following focus to transform reception into settled belonging.
A garden enclosed and concealed by growth supplies the hospitable place in which reception becomes residence.
Endurance removes any merely temporary horizon from the garden reception.
Negated seeking shows that the received place is adopted without desire for another lodging.

structural_cues: The identical final word in 18:102 and 18:107 frames both outcomes as reception; 18:108 follows only the garden instance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated guest-provision language and the immediate sequence into permanence; I infer that reception has become home for the garden's inhabitants. Alternatively, the reception term may denote prepared provision without any temporary guest implication.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is the destination where they remain.
changed_reading.after: A place first presented as prepared reception becomes home so adequate that the posture of onward-traveling guest ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier purposeful movement misses its goal while mistaking its product for good. The focus's absence of further seeking therefore reads not as passivity but as directed desire finally reaching a fitting object.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the failure of direction rather than a failure to exert effort.
Purposeful movement toward an objective supplies the active search whose misdirection precedes the focus.
Negated pursuit marks the end of search once its proper object has been attained.
A move to another state or place is the now-unneeded continuation of directed effort.

structural_cues: 18:104 describes lost striving that appears good to its agents; 18:107-108 place faithful action before satisfied permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies misdirected striving and later non-seeking; I infer a completion relation in which desire ceases to range because it has arrived. Alternatively, the two groups may be only contrasted outcomes without a psychology of fulfilled search.

changed_reading.before: Eternal residents become inactive and no longer desire.
changed_reading.after: Desire is not erased; its directional search has reached a fitting object and therefore no longer ranges elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah places a vast resource inside a depletion-and-resupply experiment. By juxtaposition, the focus's permanence can be heard as non-exhaustive abundance rather than frozen repetition: there is no demand for a changed condition because plenitude does not run out.

activation_trace.role: Vast plentiful water supplies an image of abundance that is enormous yet still finite.
Connected increase that supplies another thing contributes the mechanism of ongoing replenishment.
Exhaustion and ending create the limit that repeated supply fails to overcome before the divine words.
Enduring continuity receives a dynamic, non-depleting texture from the following comparison.
Negated change of condition becomes intelligible as no need to escape exhaustion or monotony.

structural_cues: 18:109 immediately follows the focus and repeats sea, exhaustion, words, and added supply in a counterfactual sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency plus finite abundance, depletion, and replenishment; I infer that this colors the garden's permanence as dynamically inexhaustible. A live alternative is that 18:109 concerns divine speech alone and does not characterize garden experience.

changed_reading.after: Eternity may be sustained freshness: permanence without depletion removes the pressure to seek a different condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing instruction turns to a heart leaning toward a hoped-for encounter. Read beside it, the focus's non-seeking is the consummation rather than deletion of longing: hope reaches encounter and settles into attachment.

activation_trace.role: The heart's orientation toward what it hopes for supplies desire in its anticipatory phase.
Two parties coming into encounter supplies the hoped-for arrival that can terminate ranging desire.
Negated seeking supplies desire's fulfilled phase, in which no alternate object is pursued.
Settled attachment supplies the durable form taken by fulfilled longing.

structural_cues: After describing residents who seek no transfer, 18:110 addresses the person who still hopes for encounter and must act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent completed non-seeking and prospective hope for encounter; I infer two temporal phases of one directed desire. Alternatively, 18:110 may be exhortation with no intended account of the residents' affect.

changed_reading.after: Paradise completes desire: anticipatory hope has arrived and become settled attachment rather than restless search.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the power-and-stratagem branch is more form-distant than the ordinary transfer sense; it remains anchored in focus word 6 and is governed by seeking at word 4. Render only as a lexical echo, such as 'not even a workaround,' never as the primary translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 6 as a branch-distant echo of maneuvering capacity under the negated seeking verb.

activation_trace.role: Capacity for maneuver and strategic contrivance supplies an exploratory sense of an exit-plan or workaround.
Seeking makes the possible maneuver an object that is explicitly not pursued.
Stable endurance keeps the strategic echo subordinate to the verse's clear permanence.

changed_reading.after: At an exploratory edge, they do not seek even a maneuver, workaround, or leverage by which their condition might be reconfigured.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mind-or-heart branch belongs to the same root but is morphologically distant from the abiding participle; the negated search still anchors a coherent cognitive layer. Render as an imaginal secondary echo, not as a lexical claim about the participle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 read alongside the complete absence of a searched-for alternative at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A concern settled in the mind supplies an exploratory inward counterpart to external permanence.
Negated seeking prevents an alternative condition from becoming a sustained mental project.
The range of possible conditions supplies the counterfactual horizon that never takes hold.

changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, no alternative condition gains residence in their horizon; the abode is settled in thought as well as duration.

strongest_changes: The explicit inability in 18:101 makes the focus's non-seeking read as volitional contentment rather than stated incapacity.
Repeated prepared-reception language in 18:102 and 18:107 lets 18:108 turn garden hospitality into adopted home.
Misdirected striving in 18:104 reframes no further seeking as arrival at the right object rather than passivity.
The depletion-and-resupply experiment in 18:109 opens a dynamic reading of permanence as inexhaustible renewal.
summary.what_was_special: The focus tightly joins duration, desire, and transition. Nearby context changes static endlessness into chosen settlement: reception becomes home, striving reaches its object, hope reaches encounter, and abundance need not exhaust.
remaining_uncertainties: The condition, capacity, and mental branches are legitimate activators but more form-distant than the ordinary transfer and duration senses.
Prepared reception need not itself imply temporary lodging, so the guest-to-home mechanism remains an inference from sequence.
The dynamic-renewal reading depends on adjacency to 18:109; that ayah may concern divine words without describing garden experience.
The contrast with inability does not establish that departure is actually possible; it only identifies non-seeking as the focus's stated mechanism.
